name: Mr President
source:
Aliens have made first contact with Earth! As Earth President, it is your task to carefully navigate the waters of intergalactic diplomacy! It will take, at most, five minutes.

[From [url=https://keithmcnally.itch.io/mr-president] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
外星人首次与地球接触！作为地球总统，你的任务是谨慎处理星际外交！整个过程最多只需五分钟。

[来源：[url=https://keithmcnally.itch.io/mr-president]itch.io[/url]]
